import json
p='/Users/samkim/.cursor/projects/Users-samkim-Projects-circadian/agent-transcripts/34557859-a4f7-4ec3-9c8f-662e40035a5a/34557859-a4f7-4ec3-9c8f-662e40035a5a.jsonl'

roles=set(); keys=set(); types=set()
with open(p) as f:
    for line in f:
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        n+=1
        o=json.loads(line)
        keys |= set(o.keys())
        roles.add(o.get('role') or o.get('type'))
        # nested type hints
        if isinstance(o.get('message'), dict):
            keys.add('message.'+str(list(o['message'].keys())[:12]))
            c=o['message'].get('content')
            if isinstance(c, list) and c:
                types.add(type(c[0]).__name__+':'+str(c[0].keys() if isinstance(c[0], dict) else c[0])[:80])
            elif isinstance(c, str):
                types.add('str')
        if n>=8: break
print('lines_sampled', n)
print('top_keys', sorted(keys))
print('roles', roles)
print('content_shapes', types)
"

python3 -c "
import json, collections
p='/Users/samkim/.cursor/projects/Users-samkim-Projects-circadian/agent-transcripts/34557859-a4f7-4ec3-9c8f-662e40035a5a/34557859-a4f7-4ec3-9c8f-662e40035a5a.jsonl'
names=collections.Counter(); types=collections.Counter(); roles=collections.Counter()
with open(p) as f:
    for line in f:
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        o=json.loads(line)
        roles[o.get('role') or o.get('type')] += 1
        msg=o.get('message') or {}
        c=msg.get('content')
        if isinstance(c, list):
            for part in c:
                if isinstance(part, dict):
                    types[part.get('type')] += 1
                    if part.get('name'): names[part['name']] += 1
                else:
                    types[type(part).__name__] += 1
        elif isinstance(c, str):
            types['str'] += 1
print('roles', roles)
print('part_types', types)
print('tool_names', names.most_common(30))
"
